details:
* Non-maintainer upload by the TuxCare ELS team.
   * CVE-2026-59948: Validate every package coming out of dependency
     resolution before it is installed or written to the lock file.
     Packages served by a repository or read from composer.lock were loaded
     without validation, so a malicious package with an invalid name could
     make Composer write attacker-controlled files outside the vendor
     directory. Also reject "-" prefixed source/dist urls and references.
     - debian/patches/0020-CVE-2026-59948.patch
   * CVE-2026-59946: Reject ".." bin paths escaping the package directory.
     - debian/patches/0020-CVE-2026-59948.patch
   * CVE-2026-84361: Reject Perforce source urls which are not network
     endpoints. A malicious package could set source.url to an rsh: or jsh:
     P4PORT value, making the p4 client run a local command when the package
     was installed from source.
     - debian/patches/0021-CVE-2026-84361.patch
